content: Human-labeling session — combat-skirmish-then-disengage:hard seed 1. Objective: Commander, this is a combat engagement on a 64x40 arena. You are given 4 jeeps (fast wheeled MG vehicles) at either the north staging point (4,10) or the south (4,30) depending on seed, on hold-fire orders — they will not engage on their own; you must issue attack orders explicitly. An enemy cluster of 6 riflemen sits at (28,20) under a hunt order — they advance on whichever of your jeeps is closest. Score 3 kills, return at least 3 jeeps to the recovery disc that matches your staging point — either (4,10) radius 6 or (4,30) radius 6, keep at least 1 jeep alive, within 4500 ticks.
